svg.title: HL Semaron keyboard: Semaron Kuriale
svg.text: Types Semaron Kuriale by sound, on an ANSI (US) keyboard. Each key shows what it types plain, with Shift, with Option (AltGr) and with both.
Bottom left: the key. Top left: Shift + the key.
Bottom right: Option + the key (AltGr on Windows and Linux). Top right: Option + Shift + the key.
Grey characters type themselves. A small grey word under a glyph is the sound the key stands for.
